sentences.en: From NPR, this is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 来自NPR，这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Vivek Murthy was seven years old when his mom woke him up one night,
sentences.zh: 维韦克·穆尔蒂七岁那年的一天深夜，他妈妈把他叫醒，

sentences.en: long after he'd gone to sleep.
She rushed him and his sister into their car.
sentences.zh: 她催促他和妹妹上了车。

sentences.en: I remember piling back into the back seat and my sister was sleepy, sitting next to me.
sentences.zh: 我还记得大家挤回后座，我妹妹很困，坐在我旁边。

sentences.en: Vivek's parents, who were immigrants from India, ran a medical practice in Miami.
sentences.zh: 维韦克的父母是从印度移民来的，在迈阿密开了一家诊所。

sentences.en: As they raced through the night in the car,
sentences.zh: 当汽车在夜色中疾驰时，

sentences.en: my parents told me that their patient, Gordon, had just died after a long struggle with metastatic cancer.
sentences.zh: 我父母告诉我，他们的病人戈登在与转移性癌症进行了长期抗争后刚刚去世。

sentences.en: And we were driving to a trailer park in Miami where Gordon lived
sentences.zh: 我们正驱车前往迈阿密的一个拖车公园，戈登就住在那里，

sentences.en: because my parents were worried that his widow, Ruth, would be grieving alone.
sentences.zh: 因为我父母担心他的遗孀露丝会独自一人沉浸在悲伤中。

sentences.en: And to this day, I will never forget the image of my mother
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我永远不会忘记我母亲的形象：

sentences.en: in her traditional sari, standing on the steps of that trailer,
sentences.zh: 她身穿传统的纱丽，站在那个拖车的台阶上，

sentences.en: and embracing Gordon's wife, Ruth, as they both cried and cried.
sentences.zh: 拥抱着戈登的妻子露丝，两人放声大哭。

sentences.en: And in that moment, you know, it struck me that their lives were so different,
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，你知道的，我突然意识到他们的生活是如此不同，

sentences.en: But in that moment, they were family.
sentences.zh: 但在那一刻，他们是一家人。

sentences.en: Like, not the kind of family that's chosen for you,
sentences.zh: 那种感觉，不是别人为你选择的家人，

sentences.en: but the kind that you choose for yourself.
sentences.zh: 而是你自己选择的家人。

sentences.en: Vivek is now a physician himself.
sentences.zh: 维韦克现在自己也是一名医生。

sentences.en: He has experienced what it's like to be at the bedside of sick patients
sentences.zh: 他经历过守候在重病号床边的感受，

sentences.en: to comfort the families of the dying.
sentences.zh: 也安慰过垂死病人的家属。

sentences.en: One lesson that has stayed with him
sentences.zh: 有一个教训一直伴随着他，

sentences.en: is something he learned that night when he was seven.
sentences.zh: 那是他七岁那年学到的东西。

sentences.en: In the final moments, when only the most meaningful strands of life remain,
sentences.zh: 在最后关头，当生命中最有意义的纽带仅存时，

sentences.en: it's really our human connections that rise to the top.
sentences.zh: 真正脱颖而出的其实是我们人与人之间的连接。

sentences.en: That's the clarity that we get at the end of life.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在生命尽头获得的清晰认知。

sentences.en: But it was my parents who taught me from the earliest ages
sentences.zh: 但正是我的父母从小就教导我，

sentences.en: that we don't have to wait until the end of life
sentences.zh: 我们不必等到生命行将结束时，

sentences.en: in order to recognize and act on the power of connection.
sentences.zh: 才去认识和践行连接的力量。
在那天晚上的许多年后，
